results.title: Email Marketing Cost 2026: What Will it Really Cost?
results.content:
Email marketing costs range from about $10 hourly for freelancers to $10,000+ monthly for agencies; in-house platforms like GetResponse run roughly $19–$1,099 monthly.

There is no one-size-fits-all email campaign cost or a fixed cost per email. As we’ve discussed, your email marketing cost will range from $10 per hour to $10000+ per month, depending on whether you outsource to freelancers or an email marketing agency. [...] To make this concrete, here’s how monthly cost scales across list sizes on GetResponse’s entry-level plan: 1,000 contacts → $19/month, 10,000 → $79/month, 100,000 → $539/month. [...] GetResponse Enterprise is an excellent example of a comprehensive in-house email marketing software. It offers advanced automation, detailed analytics, CRM integration, unlimited users, and 24/7 priority support for internal email marketing, with pricing starting at $1,099 monthly.
